boxes.title: Arya Samaj (1875)
items: Founded ==**Bombay, April 1875**== (**7 April**; ⚠ other notes: 10 April)
"Society of Nobles"; strongest in **Punjab**, HQ later **Lahore**
Rejected idol worship, polytheism, caste by birth, untouchability, purdah
For widow remarriage, inter-caste marriage, women's education

boxes.title: Shuddhi movement
steps: Reconvert Hindus who became **Muslims or Christians**

Political awakening in **Telangana**; women's upliftment in Andhra

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Shuddhi started by ==**Arya Samaj**==, not Brahmo or Satyashodhak
⚠ Trap: promotes idol worship → wrong, rejects it
Revivalism + reform; criticised for sharpening communal divides
